findings.message: Points at localhost: it only works on the developer machine
findings.fix: Make sure release builds use production URLs (check env-based config such as EXPO_PUBLIC_* or app.config.ts). If this host is intended, add it to allowHosts in release-lint.config.json.

findings.message: Trusts user-installed CA certificates: anyone who adds one to their phone can read the app's HTTPS traffic
findings.fix: Move <certificates src="user"/> into <debug-overrides>, which only applies to debuggable builds.

findings.message: Plain HTTP is allowed for a development host. Points at 10.0.2.2, the Android emulator's alias for the development machine
findings.fix: Remove this domain from the network security config, or keep it in a debug-only copy (android/app/src/debug/res/xml/). In Expo, check the config plugin that writes the file.
